audit.quote_check: confirmed in the copy we hold
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding quotation (Prentice 1971 p.14 §§2.2.1.1-2.2.1.2) is present verbatim in the PDF we hold at the stated page; I rendered printed p.14 (PDF p.26) and read it, and also read the cross-referenced §2.3.3.3 (p.22) and §2.3.4.1.2 (pp.24-25) in the held scanned/layout text. (2) Deciding source: a full 1971 ANU reference grammar based on primary fieldwork, the only grammar Glottolog lists and the source StressTyp2 itself cites; no later phonology, JIPA illustration, dissertation or instrumental study of Timugon stress was found in Glottolog's 22 [tih] entries or CrossRef; the 1993 SIL Sabah phonemics volume has no Timugon chapter. So the best available description is held and quoted. (3) The source supports the catalog's classification and its correction of StressTyp2 at n=4 (Prentice's weak-stress condition 'separated from the strong stress by two or more syllables' first applies a
